item.title: The Jockey case study: Turning innerwear into a branded lifestyle in India
item.description: Jockey’s journey in India is a case study in disciplined brand building. By focusing on comfort, quality, and trust—while resisting unnecessary diversification—it transformed an overlooked category into a branded, profitable, and aspirational market. In an age of hype-driven brand launches, Jockey proves that quiet dominance, executed relentlessly, can last decades. Click here to read the complete case study.

item.description: PepsiCo’s energy drink brand Sting is attempting to turn sound into its sharpest differentiator, à la Intel’s chime or Netflix’s Tudum. item.title: Microsoft elevates Asha Sharma to EVP & CEO of Microsoft Gaming
item.description: Microsoft has appointed Asha Sharma as executive vice president and CEO of Microsoft Gaming. She will report to chairman and CEO, Satya Nadella. Sharma steps into the role after previously serving as president, CoreAI Product at Microsoft, where she led the company’s AI models, applications and developer tools portfolio. item.description: Fintech platform Pine Labs has appointed Shalini Pillai as its chief marketing officer. item.title: Harpic taps Rohit Shetty for new Ultra Cleaner campaign
item.description: Harpic has introduced the Bathroom Ultra Cleaner, positioned as its first major innovation in the bathroom cleaning segment in over a decade. item.title: Amazon opens MCP Server beta for AI-led ad workflows
item.description: Amazon Ads has launched its Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server in open beta, introducing a new way for AI agents to interact with its advertising APIs. The announcement was made at the IAB Annual Leadership Meeting. The MCP Server enables AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to connect to Amazon’s advertising stack through natural language prompts.
